The '''Thape system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained an astronomical object [[Thape]], where the [[Order of Dai Bendu]],<ref name="TEA" /> a mystic [[The Force/Legends|Force]] tradition that preceded the birth of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was present at some point between around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
